# <span id="aanchor69"></span> Ticket Validation Template Editor

FLOWCAL supports the creation of validations for liquid tickets through the Ticket Validation Template Editor. Templates are created for different ticket types and these validations templates are then attached to a location. Once attached to a location the validations will be run on all tickets that are members of that location.

The following validation types are available in the Ticket Validation Template Editor:

- **Required Field** – If a data point is specified as a required field, an exception will be generated for any ticket that does not have a value for that field.

- **Min/Max** – If a value lies outside the minimum and maximum values specified, an exception will be generated.

- **Calculation Variance** - User-provided expected maximum variance between measured and calculated results for the data point. If the variance exceeds the validation set point, an exception will be generated.

- **Sequential Check** - Given an expected sequence of values, if a current value does not match the prior value, an exception will be generated.

  For the Gauge & Run ticket type, sequential validation of level and seal values are available in Prior Ticket group box.

  For the validation process to consider a pair of tickets to be in sequence, the following conditions need to be met:

  - Tickets must belong to the same location.

  - Tickets much have the same Accounting \> Meter ID value.

    Two tickets having null Meter ID values are considered to have the same Meter ID.

  Missing value is not considered to be out of sequence. For example: Exception 11852 “TKT – Indicated Volume start index is out of sequence” is not generated for a meter ticket that does not have an IV Start Index value, even if the validation is enabled in the template.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create a Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create">

<div class="procedure">

To create a new validation template:

1.  Click **New**.
2.  Type in the name of the new validation template. The name of the template must be unique.
3.  Select the ticket type from the drop-down list.
4.  Optionally select a product from the drop-down list. If left blank, the template will be applied to all tickets regardless of the ticket product.
5.  Specify the points that will be validated by this template.
6.  Click **Save**.

</div>

After creating a validation template, that template can be attached to a location. In order for the validations to be run the template must be attached to a location that contains the tickets that will be validated.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Modify">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Modify a Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Modify">

<div class="procedure">

To modify a validation template:

1.  Select the template to be edited from the drop-down menu.
2.  Click **Edit**.
3.  Make changes to the validation template.
4.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Delete">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Delete a Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Delete">

<div class="procedure">

To delete a validation template:

1.  Select the template to be deleted from the drop-down menu.
2.  Click **Delete**.

</div>

Once a validation template has been deleted it cannot be retrieved.

</div>
